question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.

(A) While teaching, / (B) she draws the diagrams very careful / (C) on the board.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect usage of the word "**careful**" in part B.
 
• The word "**careful**" is an adjective, but the sentence requires an adverb to describe the action of drawing diagrams.
 
• The correct word should be "**carefully**", which is an adverb and modifies the verb "**draws**" appropriately.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part B** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"While teaching, she draws the diagrams very **carefully** on the board."*
